status_meaning: PASS verifies the stated behavior, not complete information coverage or hidden evaluator acceptance.

rows.requirement: Read organizer-selected organisation numbers, including unseen companies.
rows.behavior: Explicit --input or SIGNALPOST_INPUT; actual file rows drive processing.
rows.independent_verification: Independent single, array, JSONL, CSV and unfamiliar-CWD launches.

rows.requirement: Support nine-character textual IDs and the starter JSON batch wrapper.
rows.behavior: Leading zeros preserved; organisation_numbers wrapper now expanded.
rows.independent_verification: Independent starter_wrapper and ordered CSV cases.
rows.limitation: Other organizer input keys/encoding are unpublished.

rows.requirement: Return one terminal result for every supplied input.
rows.behavior: Ordered JSONL, failed rows retained, no silent truncation.
rows.independent_verification: Independent malformed four-row case, duplicate array and controlled source failures.

rows.requirement: Preserve duplicate input rows rather than unique-company cardinality.
rows.source_section: Output contract does not specify duplicates
rows.behavior: Per-row input_ref and ordered envelope.
rows.independent_verification: Independent array emits three rows including repeated ID.
rows.limitation: Behavior passes locally; official duplicate semantics remain unpublished.

rows.requirement: Use six distinct terminal availability states.
rows.behavior: terminal_state is a six-state value; source attempts stay separately diagnosed.
rows.independent_verification: Observed available, failed, not_available and blocked via independent cases.
rows.limitation: Not every rare state has a live sample; exact per-section wire representation unknown.

rows.requirement: Represent identity/brand, accounts/history and leadership/workplaces sections.
rows.behavior: identity_brand, accounts_history, leadership_workplaces always present.
rows.independent_verification: Independent parser checks required sections on every output row.
rows.limitation: Presence is not evidence of information coverage; see R15–R18.

rows.requirement: Represent sites/profiles, hiring/activity, evidence and refresh sections.
rows.behavior: website_owned_profiles, hiring_activity, claims_evidence_states, refresh_changes.
rows.independent_verification: Independent section/cardinality parser and real HTTP views.
rows.limitation: Canonical names are internal, not organizer-approved JSON field names.

rows.requirement: Publish only exact-company, source-supported facts.
rows.behavior: Company anchor, labelled role/workplace subjects and publication graph checks.
rows.independent_verification: Four source identities checked; source hashes and role/workplace bindings inspected.
rows.limitation: No confirmed wrong-company association in assessed sample; not exhaustive human adjudication.

rows.requirement: Attach source, retrieval time, relevant period, hash and extraction method.
rows.behavior: Claim -> evidence -> snapshot; JSON pointers or permitted excerpts.
rows.existing_or_added_tests: M01 provenance; new role-source pointer tests
rows.independent_verification: Independent dict parser and current-source pointer checks found and corrected role locators.
rows.limitation: Historical defective role pointers remain historical; no raw-role-body archive or retroactive rewrite.

rows.requirement: Do not invent financial amounts or replace missing facts with zero.
rows.behavior: Numeric metrics withheld without supported unit/currency/period/scope.
rows.independent_verification: Retained accounts replay publishes metadata and zero numeric metrics.
rows.limitation: Correct withholding does not satisfy financial coverage.

rows.requirement: Preserve evidence and expose material changes; repeats are idempotent.
rows.behavior: --previous-state, canonical state, typed before/after evidence.
rows.independent_verification: Separate CLI baseline -> changed -> repeated snapshot; one change then zero.
rows.limitation: Compatible settings required. Changing default batch size changes budget fingerprint; fixed explicit budget workaround independently verified.

rows.requirement: Provide pinned setup and one reproducible evaluator command.
rows.behavior: Declared uv install, Python launcher and path arguments.
rows.independent_verification: Fresh isolated install and actual subprocess execution; final-SHA check recorded in freeze receipt.

rows.requirement: Finish inside the equally supplied resource budget.
rows.behavior: Hard/soft/reserve/request accounting with explicit config/environment inputs.
rows.independent_verification: Scale/provenance verifier and controlled failures complete without missing rows.
rows.limitation: Numeric official CPU/memory/time/request/cost limits and injection names are not published. Defaults are internal.

rows.requirement: Respect permitted access, source terms, robots and server-side credentials.
rows.behavior: Existing gateway and source contracts retained; no new provider or paid credential.
rows.independent_verification: 78/80 authorized company-data requests; no new cohort, PDFs or prohibited platform access.
rows.limitation: This does not grant new PDF/provider rights; site-specific terms remain applicable.

rows.requirement: Show legal identity and public brand where supported.
rows.source_section: What the company profile should show
rows.behavior: All four real legal names; public brand needs independent accepted-site proof.
rows.existing_or_added_tests: M02/M03; new number and municipality checks
rows.independent_verification: Current official identity bodies agree with preserved company identities.
rows.limitation: Legal identity works; no verified site-derived public brand in four-company sample.

rows.requirement: Show latest filed financial results and available history.
rows.source_section: What the company profile should show
rows.behavior: 18 records/126 metadata claims in preserved four-company sample; zero metrics.
rows.independent_verification: Current Equinor account body and production replay confirm missing explicit scale proof.
rows.limitation: Amounts exist in response, but safe unit/scale publication is unsupported; PDF path is disabled internally.

rows.requirement: Show leadership and registered workplaces.
rows.source_section: What the company profile should show
rows.behavior: 44 role rows and 57 workplaces in preserved sample.
rows.existing_or_added_tests: M02/M09; new locator and municipality regressions
rows.independent_verification: Current role bodies match original hashes; retained-response replay validates source-bound workplace facts.
rows.limitation: Record bindings checked; full independent fact-by-fact precision is not measured.

rows.requirement: Show verified company websites and owned profiles.
rows.behavior: Registry-linked candidates remain candidates until exact ownership acceptance.
rows.independent_verification: Preserved four-company sample: zero verified sites; Equinor ambiguous, three no registry candidate.
rows.limitation: Missing discovery/reach and insufficient accepted ownership evidence; not confirmed absence of websites.

rows.requirement: Show supported hiring and dated public activity.
rows.behavior: Extraction operates only after accepted exact-site proof, with date/employer checks.
rows.independent_verification: Four real profiles publish no hiring/activity claims; unsupported propositions abstain.
rows.limitation: No reached accepted site in sample; external jobs/news providers remain disabled.

rows.requirement: Explain supported business facts, changes and remaining unknowns.
rows.behavior: Deterministic cited factual summary and unknown sections.
rows.independent_verification: Independent parser checks fact/evidence references; real rendered profiles inspected.
rows.limitation: Summary remains technical and verbose; no official usefulness score or natural-language research assistant is proven.

rows.requirement: Let users find, compare and verify on desktop and mobile.
rows.behavior: Number/name search, scoped compare/verify/history and source detail routes.
rows.independent_verification: Actual HTTP checks and Chromium at 375/1366 px; overflow reproduced and repaired.
rows.limitation: Read-only saved results; new company research occurs through CLI, not an in-page live research action.

rows.requirement: Use 50/30/12/8 scoring and 70/30 company/fact recall weighting.
rows.production: No local program can certify an official score.
rows.behavior: No synthetic score is treated as competition qualification.
rows.independent_verification: Confirmed current published rubric; no official run or checked-pool labels obtained.
rows.limitation: 65 overall is qualification; low recall alone is not a separate eligibility threshold.

rows.requirement: Include a 100-company smoke report and exact version/run instructions.
rows.behavior: Historical 100-company evidence is packaged and labelled with its older source SHA.
rows.independent_verification: Historical receipts verify; no new 100-company acquisition.
rows.limitation: Raw historical M12 bundle absent on VM; no current-source full 100-company live rerun authorized.

rows.requirement: Accept a frozen BRREG snapshot and its native column names.
rows.behavior: Canonical/native CSV and JSONL keys; as-of/source flags now honored.
rows.independent_verification: Unfamiliar-CWD native CSV/JSONL subprocesses, earlier/future-date cases.
rows.limitation: Exact organizer snapshot mount/format/licence is unpublished; frozen-only fallback currently supplies minimal identity.

rows.requirement: Match the exact organizer JSON keys and extra-field policy.
rows.source_section: Output contract supplies semantics, no schema file
rows.behavior: Current canonical output is parseable but explicitly provisional.
rows.independent_verification: Compared current starter minimal example and executable batch output; these differ from each other and our output.
rows.limitation: No authoritative JSON Schema, parser or accepted wire fixture found in linked materials or current archive.

rows.requirement: Use the actual organizer invocation, hosting and state handoff.
rows.behavior: Pasteable CLI and local read-only HTTP app; explicit prior-state file.
rows.independent_verification: Standalone launch, stdout/stderr/exit-code handling, real server routes and state scenarios verified.
rows.limitation: No mandated participant API/port/container/hosting interface, runtime variable names or state-handoff spec published.

rows.requirement: Emit starter-style availability/confidence/evidence identifiers.
rows.behavior: Our state/evidence_id/refresh.changes and operations list differ from minimal example.
rows.independent_verification: Observed starter example versus executable module/profile envelope mismatch.
rows.limitation: Confidence is not calibrated probability; do not silently add guessed aliases as an official schema.

rows.requirement: Use run-start cutoff unless an authorized value is supplied.
rows.source_section: Corpus supplies cutoff but no injection/default rule
rows.behavior: Configured/evaluator cutoff overrides internal default; post-cutoff facts withheld.
rows.existing_or_added_tests: M02/M09 cutoff tests; new frozen-date checks
rows.independent_verification: Explicit earlier/future-date scenarios and original live cutoff documented.
rows.limitation: Undated workplaces can be withheld under run-start default; actual organizer cutoff semantics remain unknown.

rows.requirement: Keep exact-version evidence reproducible and ownership/access honest.
rows.source_section: Submit an exact version; Winner verification; Code/privacy
rows.production: Git branch; source receipts; final freeze receipt
rows.behavior: Keep repository PRIVATE; owner read-only access remains a separate organizer question.
rows.independent_verification: Source hashes archived; no visibility change, PR, merge or competition submission.
rows.limitation: Organizer clone access not verified. An open-source licence/public visibility is not inferred as a general platform requirement.

rows.requirement: Use measured learning, frameworks and extraction strategies as appropriate.
rows.source_section: Reference architecture; Evaluate as a control loop
rows.behavior: No framework/model/browser/PDF is silently made mandatory.
rows.independent_verification: No new discovery/provider strategy promoted without approved rights.
rows.limitation: Playbook and learning harness recommend experiments; they do not supply hidden evaluator code.

rows.requirement: Run npm check commands shown under contract Local checks.
rows.production: No participant package.json; current public starter is Python.
rows.behavior: These commands are not the declared participant research launcher.
rows.independent_verification: Recorded as an unresolved tooling reference, not silently imposed on participant code.
rows.limitation: No corresponding scripts in the participant archive; cannot execute unavailable organizer-site checks.
